declared_purpose: A XiaoHongShu collection and interaction toolkit for searching notes, retrieving feeds, user information and comments, and following users or liking posts. The entry promises automatic cookie/signature handling, guest access and optional web_session authentication, for legitimate research and analysis (SKILL.md:2–4, 235–240). Supporting source adds authentication helpers, comment mutations and view reporting. These are callable capabilities; the entry does not require every operation or every implemented data field for every task.

data_operations.operation: Read local configuration and evaluate configured values.
data_operations.data_scope: Protocol constants, cryptographic keys, security endpoint and default browser headers. No browser-cookie or user-document read is shown.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local Config instance and encryption components.
data_operations.condition: Configuration is loaded on import; get() evaluates the requested supplied configuration value.

data_operations.operation: Keep caller-provided authentication and connection settings in memory; generate session identifiers.
data_operations.source: Constructor arguments, clock, random values and packaged configuration.
data_operations.data_scope: web_session, proxy_url, sid, supplied or generated did, generated a1 and its MD5-derived webId, timestamps and request identifiers.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: XHS_Session fields and its client cookie jar. cookies and get_fp() expose local state to their caller.
data_operations.condition: Session construction and initialization. Supplied web_session is installed after initial security registration.

data_operations.operation: Request security scripting data and retain derived cookies.
data_operations.source: Initialization payload, session headers and security-service response.
data_operations.data_scope: callFrom, callback, browser-style headers and applicable client cookies; response data is decoded into websectiga and sec_poison_id.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: https://as.xiaohongshu.com/api/sec/v1/scripting; returned values enter the local cookie jar.
data_operations.condition: Every normal initialization. This call disables request signing, while using the initialized HTTP session.

data_operations.operation: Transmit an encoded browser-profile preset for security registration.
data_operations.source: get_fingerprint() ultimately replaces its generated dictionary with a hardcoded sample.
data_operations.data_scope: Browser, hardware, locale and environment claims; fingerprint hashes; sample cookie identifiers in x57; note/login navigation and an xsec_token-bearing reference in x66. These are preset claims, not measurements of the current machine.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Full profile serialized, Base64-encoded and DES-encrypted into profileData sent to https://as.xiaohongshu.com/api/sec/v1/shield/webprofile.
data_operations.condition: Every normal initialization, including authenticated sessions. The profile payload is built before request() updates the local fingerprint, so that update does not replace the serialized sample. Supplied web_session has not yet entered the cookie jar.

data_operations.operation: Activate guest access or install supplied authentication.
data_operations.source: Presence or absence of the caller's web_session argument.
data_operations.data_scope: Guest activation sends an empty body with the current session context; authenticated operation installs web_session for subsequent client requests.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Guest activation: https://edith.xiaohongshu.com/api/sns/web/v1/login/activate. Supplied credential: local client cookie jar, then applicable authenticated requests.
data_operations.condition: Activation occurs only when web_session is None. The authenticated branch skips activation.

data_operations.operation: Derive request signatures and trace identifiers; update a local fingerprint snapshot.
data_operations.source: Current a1, time, random values, URL path, params, data and fingerprint fields.
data_operations.data_scope: Request-bound signatures, timestamps and trace IDs. Local fp.x57 receives the current cookie string and fp.x66 the request URL. x-s-common encodes only its selected fingerprint fields plus a1 and constants; it does not serialize x57 or x66.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local session headers and fingerprint; headers accompany request()'s selected destination. Packaged destinations are XiaoHongShu security and API services.
data_operations.condition: need_encrypt=True and a1 exists. search_notes supplies json=, which this signing preprocessing does not include as data.

data_operations.operation: Route requests through the HTTP client and optionally a proxy; retry requests.
data_operations.source: Selected URL, request fields, caller proxy and client environment settings.
data_operations.data_scope: API traffic and connection metadata. Repeated attempts can repeat a mutation; no idempotency mechanism is shown.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Selected endpoint and, when configured, the proxy transport. Proxy visibility into HTTPS payloads is not established.
data_operations.condition: Explicit HTTP or SOCKS proxy configuration is optional. trust_env=True enables dependency-controlled environment settings. Client errors trigger up to five attempts by default; successful security verification triggers resubmission.

data_operations.operation: Request search results, notes, feeds, comments and current-account information.
data_operations.source: Caller-selected keywords, IDs, access tokens, categories and pagination; platform responses.
data_operations.data_scope: Search terms and filters, note/user IDs, xsec_token, feed category and cursors. Responses contain the requested platform content or account information; exact server fields are not fixed by this source.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Corresponding search/notes, user_posted, feed, homefeed, comment/page and user/me endpoints on edith.xiaohongshu.com. Normal responses return to the API caller.
data_operations.condition: Only when the corresponding API method is called and the response handler permits return. Retrieval does not itself invoke view-reporting methods.

data_operations.operation: Submit follows, likes, comment posts/replies and comment-like cancellation.
data_operations.source: Caller-selected target IDs, comment text and at_users.
data_operations.data_scope: Target user/note/comment identifiers, posted content and mentioned-user list, associated with applicable session authentication.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: edith.xiaohongshu.com user/follow, note/like, comment/post, comment/like and comment/dislike endpoints. These request platform-side relationship or content changes.
data_operations.condition: Explicit invocation of the corresponding method. Posting/replying and comment-like cancellation are supporting implementation capabilities beyond the entry's named follow/like examples; server acceptance and retention remain unknown.

data_operations.operation: Construct subcomment retrieval and comment deletion requests, but fail before dispatch.
data_operations.data_scope: Subcomment query parameters or deletion target IDs.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local request preparation only on these implementations; no successful remote deletion is established.
data_operations.condition: Both methods pass their dictionary as request()'s third positional argument, max_retries. range(max_retries) then receives a dictionary and fails before the HTTP call.

data_operations.operation: Accumulate fetched comments temporarily and output counts.
data_operations.data_scope: Complete returned comment objects retained in a local list; page counts printed; final return contains note_id and total count.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Function-local memory, stdout and caller. No file export is implemented.
data_operations.condition: get_all_comments() only, bounded by has_more and max_crawl_times, default three. Its explicit subcomment crawling code is commented out despite the documented promise.

data_operations.operation: Send a login-code request containing a phone number.
data_operations.data_scope: phone, zone and login request type.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GET query to https://edith.xiaohongshu.com/api/sns/web/v2/login/send_code; response returns to caller.
data_operations.condition: Explicit send_code() invocation; not normal session initialization.

data_operations.operation: Create/poll login QR state and initialize/poll a verification challenge.
data_operations.source: Caller authentication context and platform-issued QR/challenge values.
data_operations.data_scope: QR type, qr_id, code; verification type, UUID, business, sourceSite and returned rid. scan_login stores did and sid locally; active code does not send them to an App service.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: edith.xiaohongshu.com login/qrcode/create, login/qrcode/status, redcaptcha/v2/qr/init and redcaptcha/v2/qr/status/query.
data_operations.condition: Explicit helper calls, or verification handling when sid is configured. Both helpers can stop with an instruction to implement App integration. Initialization's automatic scan_login() call omits its required sid argument, so that automatic path fails before QR creation.

data_operations.operation: Submit note-view telemetry when directly invoked.
data_operations.source: Metrics-method arguments and fixed payload values.
data_operations.data_scope: note_id/type, request_id, viewer_id, author_id, stay_seconds and engagement/follow flags. Several flags are fixed assertions, not measured behavior.
data_operations.condition: Direct enter_metrics_report() or exit_metrics_report() invocation. These are separate reporting actions, not automatic additions to normal note retrieval.

data_operations.operation: Fetch current-account information on the attempted read-count-increase path; later reporting is blocked.
data_operations.data_scope: Current-account response is fetched to obtain viewer_id. Intended later processing obtains author/type and reports a generated request ID and optionally randomized dwell time.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Initial user/me request to edith.xiaohongshu.com; subsequent note-detail and telemetry dispatch is not established on this path.
data_operations.condition: add_note_readnum() only. With the declared aiohttp response type, subscripting an un-awaited json() result prevents normal continuation after the first fetch; the later note-detail parsing repeats this defect.

data_operations.operation: Inspect responses, infer error categories and emit diagnostic records.
data_operations.source: Request URL/params/data, response status/body/headers and session cookie jar.
data_operations.data_scope: Full query-bearing URLs, truncated params/data previews, some full response bodies, and web_session in selected warnings. Message matching classifies muted, expired, denied or banned states. json= search bodies are not included by the request_info formatter.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local response-processing memory, exceptions returned to caller and Loguru-configured sinks. Durable storage or onward transport is not specified.
data_operations.condition: Response inspection is enabled by default. Recognized success logs request_info; specified errors log credentials or response bodies. Client failures and generic exceptions also log request information.

data_operations.operation: Output retrieved content in documented example workflows.
data_operations.source: API responses parsed by entry-document examples.
data_operations.data_scope: Basic example prints the entire parsed response; other examples print note titles, author/commenter nicknames, comment text, counts and current-account statistics. Chat-link guidance includes a note access token in the destination URL.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: stdout if examples run; chat recipients only if the document's optional link-output guidance is followed.
data_operations.condition: Example or document-guided output paths, not an automatic export by the API wrappers. A normal response may remain solely with its caller.

data_operations.operation: Decode a bundled sample and print the result.
data_operations.source: Hardcoded encoded_p in the standalone decoder.
data_operations.data_scope: Decoded sample JSON or text; its exact contents are not established here.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local memory and stdout; no network call or file write in this path.
data_operations.condition: Only when decrypt_xs_xsc.py is executed as the main script.

data_operations.operation: Close network resources without explicitly clearing all retained authentication state.
data_operations.data_scope: Connections are closed and client references dropped. Stored web_session, sid and fingerprint fields are not cleared by close_session().
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Remaining XHS_Session object memory. This is volatile retention, not demonstrated disk persistence or remote deletion.

potential_excess.data_scope: Historical sample cookie identifiers in x57 and access-token-bearing navigation in x66; associated hardcoded profile context.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Packaged XhsFpGenerator.py literal and encrypted profileData sent to as.xiaohongshu.com/api/sec/v1/shield/webprofile.
potential_excess.condition: Normal session initialization uses the replacement preset, including when current authentication is supplied.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Automatic security registration supports platform access. No entry requirement calls for disclosure of a historical sample's cookie identifiers or signed navigation.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Obtain whatever security registration state is actually required for functioning guest/authenticated API access.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove historical identifiers and signed navigation from the packaged preset. Use minimal synthetic/current context where needed; omit or redact x57/x66 fields that the endpoint accepts without them.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve successful security registration and signatures. Endpoint field requirements are undocumented, so omission requires validation. This narrows data in the registration action rather than establishing that the whole action is redundant.

potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Loguru warning records and their configured sinks.
potential_excess.condition: Muted, expired-login, permission-denied, banned or blockedps response branches.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Authentication is needed for selected platform operations; diagnostic logging does not require reproducing its credential.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Report the failure category and raise the corresponding exception.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove web_session from warnings; use a non-secret correlation identifier if correlation is required.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep error classification, status and exception behavior. No API request or authentication payload needs to change.

potential_excess.data_scope: Phone numbers, note access tokens, QR identifiers/codes and comment text appearing in URLs or data previews.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: request_info diagnostic records emitted through Loguru.
potential_excess.condition: Default response logging, retries and exception paths. URLs retain full query strings; data previews are truncated, not redacted.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Selected API actions require these values at the platform endpoint. The additional diagnostic disclosure is an implementation choice.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Transmit the required request and retain useful operational diagnostics.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Log method, endpoint path, status and a non-secret correlation ID; omit query values and body previews by default.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Leave actual API parameters and normal caller returns intact. This removes data from an additional logging action, not from required platform requests.

potential_excess.data_scope: Unfiltered response text or JSON, potentially containing returned content, account information or security context.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Loguru error sinks, separately from the response or exception delivered to the caller.
potential_excess.condition: Unrecognized security errors and unmatched response-message branches.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Failure diagnosis needs a failure category; full platform response duplication is not an explicit collection/output requirement.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Detect failure and give the caller an actionable error.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Omit full response dumps by default; log an allowlisted status/error code and sanitized message.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve caller-accessible error handling and security-challenge fields needed for verification. Do not treat the ordinary caller return as this extra disclosure.

potential_excess.data_scope: Stored web_session and sid; the last cookie string in fp.x57 when populated by encrypted requests.
potential_excess.condition: The object remains referenced after closure. Fingerprint credential retention depends on which requests occurred.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Session credentials support active authenticated operations. The documented close operation does not establish a need to retain them afterward.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Close connections and end the active session.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Clear stored credential references and sensitive fingerprint fields on final closure.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve active-session use. If credential reuse after closure is required, make that lifecycle explicit. Clearing references does not guarantee memory erasure or delete caller-held copies.

unknowns: The source audit is complete; runtime success, server-side storage/sharing, response contents, cookie issuance and retention are unresolved. No external behavior was retrieved or assumed.
Required webprofile fields and security-request necessity are undocumented. Whether proposed profile omissions preserve access requires endpoint validation.

Dependency internals are absent: UserAgent.Random() I/O, aiohttp environment/proxy and cookie-domain behavior, and Loguru sink configuration are unknown. No durable log storage or remote log recipient is established.
SKILL.md:171–173 advertises get_user_info(user_id), but scripts/request/web/apis/user.py contains only follow_user; retrieval of another user's profile details is unresolved.

Deletion and subcomment retrieval are blocked by positional-argument defects; automatic QR login and add_note_readnum also have identified execution defects. Intended downstream effects must not be treated as completed operations.
App scanning integrations are commented out and explicitly unimplemented. Successful end-to-end QR login or challenge resolution is not established.
search_notes sends json= while signing preprocessing uses data=. Whether the platform accepts that signature is unknown.
Validity and ownership of embedded sample identifiers, and exact decoded_p contents in the standalone example, are unknown. Their values were not reproduced.
